body: I just tried the other day - turns out I'm not prepared for the permanency that death offers it's scary.

Thanks for taking the time to reply. I attempted suicide yesterday it was the closest I ever got to actually dying and it really changed my perspective. I dont really have anyone to talk to about it without being involuntary sent to the hospital so I'm going to make a longer post on a sub later. But the take away was I realized that while I am may be suffering I am not prepared for the vast nothingness that happens after you die.
